checks.name: setup, status refresh and immediate touch fallback use only injected callbacks
all required setup states are inspectable and produce safe links
public PEM and CA-only profile download; no private bytes in download or UI
callback failures and cancellation show safe retry copy without error contents
unsafe origin and malformed status are rejected before rendering
out-of-order refresh and late disposed callbacks cannot change the current view
remove and root replacement require keyboard-accessible local confirmation
disabling keeps the certificate; repeated mount/dispose owns only its root
export rejects secret or mixed-purpose payloads without starting a download
phone diagnostic reports actual page context and rejects synthetic events as sensor proof
required wide states and 390px narrow layout fit with reduced motion and visible focus
